finding.claim: OS command injection in /ping: the unauthenticated query parameter `host` is concatenated into a shell command string passed to child_process.exec, which runs it through a shell.

trace.note: Route handler for GET /ping with no auth middleware
req.query.host concatenated into shell command and run via exec
Command stdout is returned in the response, so injected output is visible to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: No validation, allowlist or escaping of host. No auth middleware (app has none). exec uses a shell, so metacharacters such as ; | $() are interpreted. Express may give an array or object for repeated or bracketed params, but string concatenation still yields attacker-controlled text.

verdict.reason: tools.js:7 passes "ping -c 1 " + req.query.host to shell-based exec on an unauthenticated route (tools.js:6, the only file, no middleware or validation), and tools.js:11 returns stdout, so a payload like "; id" runs and its output is returned.
